text:
Irene: Quick capture from ClearVista onboarding call — two product asks that are tied to their renewal (5w): (1) a consolidated CSV export that shows per-route token usage + dollar cost AND an extra column where CS/Product can map each route to an internal product feature name (their FP&A + PMs need this mapping to tie spend to feature owners); (2) a dashboard-level 'quiet mode' that suppresses non-actionable alerts during configured business hours and allows per-route threshold tuning.
Caleb: Nice detail. Can you paste the exact quote they used for the mapping ask?
Irene: Quote: 'We need to show execs not just that tokens burned, but which product feature drove the spend. A column with our feature id would let us roll up ownership.'
Sam: Flagging renewal risk. If we can ship the mapping column + interim cost numbers quickly, paging the PMs will calm down.
Ravi: Dev high-level: (A) CSV export with route + token counts + $ column: if pricing join exists it's ~3w (inc. QA). Adding a free-text "feature_id" column that's editable by CS/Product is trivial on the CSV side but requires a storage surface and tiny UI to tag routes -> ~2w. (B) Quiet mode: org-scheduled quiet hours + per-route threshold UI behind FF ~2w. Per-route threshold tuning implies some instrumenting of alerting rules, add'l ~1w. So overall ~4-6w for full feature set.
Nina: Could we stage: 1) ship CSV with route, tokens, $ (computed nightly) + a 'feature_id' column left blank for manual CS fill-in; 2) follow with UI tagging so they can manage mappings. That meets their FP&A urgent ask and buys time.
Irene: They explicitly asked for the mapping column. They'll take manual tagging for 2-3 weeks if we commit to UI. They also asked for silence during standups — quiet mode is high impact.
Caleb: Action items: 1) Ravi to confirm whether pricing join exists in current pipeline and provide firm ETAs for interim vs full; 2) Irene to upload sample CSV layout and example mapping from their side; 3) Sam to create productboard entry and mark renewal-risk + request beta access. Check-in 48h.
product-bot: Created PB-8021 "ClearVista: per-route cost export + feature mapping column + quiet-mode" tags=[cs, renewal-risk, telemetry].
Sam: I'll add a short note about operational stopgap: CS can run a weekly export and manually add feature mappings until UI ships — offer as escalation path.
Ravi: I'll spike pricing join and the storage surface for mapping tomorrow and post blockers by EOD. If join exists, interim CSV + manual mapping could ship in ~10 business days.
Nina: I'll draft the UX for per-route tag management and quiet-mode toggle and post mocks to the thread.
Irene: Uploaded their sample CSV and an example feature map to the shared drive (link). They confirmed they can beta-test the UI and will accept interim weekly exports.
Caleb: Thanks — marking this as high touch. Sam please loop AM for renewal conversation.
Sam: Adding renewal flag and AM note to PB-8021. Will coordinate AM outreach. :thumbsup:
Irene: Will DM any exec asks; keeping this hot.
